budget.node_purpose: Optional pressure-based working-memory checkpoint over the native conversation journal; at most two accepted summaries per thread under the existing audited call and cost scope
budget.input_scale: Structured pair-safe segments target at most 32000 estimated tokens and 120000 message characters, including stable system/task and final checkpoint instruction; full SDK ceiling remains independently enforced. Oversized indivisible batches stop without truncating evidence. At most two accepted segments under the existing thread allowance.
required_outputs: Current research question, user corrections, completed and pending work without adding a research conclusion
Important evidence, company, period, unit, calculation identity and unresolved disagreements; exact originals remain in native checkpoint readers
budget.schema_burden: Plain continuation checkpoint, approximately 2000 output tokens as a soft target, not a report or planning form. Thinking and final text share the unchanged 12000-token provider cap.
budget.materiality_quality_risk: Lossy summary can omit important qualifiers; deterministic replay proves restoration and identities only. Full evidence remains readable. Reject nonshrinking, empty or truncated summaries; do not retry automatically.
budget.comparable_run_evidence: Two saved continuations, 16 real requests; offline policy and native checkpoint replay only. No claim of measured token savings, cache hit improvements or better research decisions. Authorize real verification separately.
